{{Top|leg}}
[[Armo Drane]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Tso Sook Drane]], knew an individual named '''Jollar'''. Arno sent a letter to his wife wishing her and Jollar well while he was being sent to a [[Detention area|detention]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. The letter was recovered aboard ''Purge'' after its occupants were decimated by a [[plague]] so it is unlikely that it reached her before it was released to the public for academic purposes in relation to the history of ''Purge''.
